_about: Per-parish registry of parish council and planning/zoning agenda platforms. 'platform' selects the adapter in agendas.py. 'skip_bodies' are left out of meetings/alerts unless --all-bodies is given. 'terms' are extra alert patterns (regex, case-insensitive) added to the categories in keywords.json for that parish only. Status: 'verified' entries work; 'probed-unusable' and 'unprobed' entries carry what a probe found. 'layout' (CivicPlus) adjusts item splitting: item_start (extra item-number regex; the number it captures is also the matter file, as for St. Bernard dockets), ignore (page-header lines), section (mixed-case heading regex), agenda_end (extra closing-line regex), matter (regex pulling a matter number from the item title). Verified 2026-10-17.

st-charles.name: St. Charles Parish
notes: Council items carry the matter file (2026-0340), type, action and pass flag. P&Z Commission items are title-only and carry the case number (2026-12-R rezoning, -SPU special permit use, -MIN minor resubdivision, -HOP home occupation).
The council ordinance for a rezoning does not cite the P&Z case number. 'track' links them on applicant and lot text; the matter history then shows 'Planning Commission Recommended Approval/Denial'.

Ordinances are introduced at one council meeting and heard at a later one. The hearing date is a heading line in the agenda just before the introduced ordinances; 'items' copies it onto each one as hearing_date.
P&Z minutes stay in Draft on Legistar. The P&Z vote shows up in the council matter's history and its 'Minutes' attachment.

ascension.name: Ascension Parish
notes: Meeting ids are CivicClerk agendaIds (Meetings/{agendaId}), not event ids.

Regular Council meetings post agendas and packets but no minutes, and the item vote fields are empty. Council outcomes are not online: read the next agenda (an ordinance moves from 'Introduction of Ordinance' to 'Public Hearing'), watch the meeting video, or request the minutes (la-public-records-request).
Planning Commission, Zoning Commission, Board of Adjustments, the drainage boards and the council committees do post minutes.
Zoning cases are 'Zoning Review ID: PZ-NNNN.YY'. Code amendments are DC-YY.NN (development code) and ZT-YY.NN (zoning tables).

st-james.name: St. James Parish

categories.5: Keep St. James Parish Beautiful Board

skip_bodies: Keep St. James Parish Beautiful Board
notes: Agendas and minutes are copier scans with no text layer. agendas.py OCRs them with tesseract at 300 dpi and caches the text by file id and PDF hash. Expect OCR typos ('Parsih'); check the PDF before quoting.
There is no parish zoning layer (see parish-assessor-gis); land-use items come to the Planning Commission and council as land-use or 'Industrial' district changes under the parish land use ordinance.

east-baton-rouge.name: East Baton Rouge Parish (Metro Council)

categories.23: Local Industrial Tax Exemption Program Committee
categories.37: Capitol House Economic Development District Board of Commissioners

notes: City-parish government: the Metropolitan Council is both the parish council and the Baton Rouge city council. Agendas have a text layer; some Metro Council postings are one-page scanned notices that list no items.
AgendaCenter's year listing needs the X-Requested-With header (sent on every request).

Zoning cases: 'Case NN-YY' (rezoning), 'PA-NN-YY' (Comprehensive Land Use Plan amendment), PUD/ISPUD/SPUD/CUP-NN-YY. The Planning Commission agenda separates items that go on to the Metro Council from those it decides alone. The Metro Council introduces Planning Commission cases under 'PLANNING AND ZONING INTRODUCTIONS' and hears them at a later meeting.
The Local ITEP Committee is the parish's 2025-rules ITEP body (see itep-lookup); it posts rarely.

plaquemines.name: Plaquemines Parish
notes: Agendas have a text layer. Items nest ('7. Building Permits' > 'a) Construction Permits:' > '1. ...'); item numbers repeat across levels.

The council approves parish construction permits by 'Application No. YYYY-NNN' (LNG terminals, plant work, well plug-and-abandon) and Business Occupancy Certificates naming the zoning district. Rezonings are ordinances amending Ordinance No. 142 (the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance) by application number; the plain-language DIGEST follows each ordinance.
Deferred ordinances say '(DEFERRED & CARRIED OVER FROM ...)' with each prior date.

layout.ignore: ^\s*(?:AGENDA FOR THE .*,|MEETING OF THE PLAQUEMINES PARISH COUNCIL,|\d:\d\d P\.M\., POINTE-A-LA|\d+ HWY\. 15,|ALSO STREAMED LIVE)

st-bernard.name: St. Bernard Parish

categories.4: Housing Redevelopment Quality of Life Commission Agendas

layout.ignore: PUBLIC NOTICE - ST\. BERNARD PARISH COUNCIL MEETING|^\s*Email: |Page \d+ of \d+\s*$|^Sign Interpreter|^interested person contact

notes: Agendas have a text layer. The council agenda PDF carries the packet (draft proceedings extracts) after the agenda; reading stops at the 'Approved by:' line.
Council ordinances are 'Summary No. NNNN' with their history above the title (P&Z recommendation, introduced, public hearing, tabled dates). Titles are in capitals.
Planning Commission and BZA items are keyed by docket: Z-YYYY-NNN rezoning, S- resubdivision, TC- zoning text change, V- variance.
